item.description: SRO Motorsports Group Asiaは、TOYOTA GAZOO Racingとのオフィシャルセーフティカーパートナーシップを延長したことを発表した。これにより、同社は2026年を通じて、GT World Challenge Asia powered by AWSおよびJapan Cupに車両を供給する。

item.title: TOYOTA GAZOO Racing and SRO Asia extend Official Safety Car Partnership
item.description: SRO Motorsports Group Asia is pleased to announce the extension of an Official Safety Car Partnership with TOYOTA GAZOO Racing that will see the manufacturer supply its cars to GT World Challenge Asia powered by AWS and Japan Cup throughout 2026.

item.title: GT World Challenge Global: Season eight of continental contest launches with four events in three weeks
item.description: GT World Challenge powered by AWS raises the curtain on its 2026 season next weekend (28/29 March) with races in Australia and America, while the opening rounds in Asia (4/5 April) and Europe (11/12 April) are not far behind.
